holder-quote: The Creler’s head focused on him. It loosed another salvo. Belt vanished. Tommie ran on. He screamed, charging at the Creler. It reared up, and Ceria saw Tommie plant his feet.
effect-quote: He flew. Ksmvr jerked as Tommie jumped as high as Ksmvr did. The man was aiming at the adult’s mouth. Ceria stared. He was going to make it. He was going to do it!
